description: The agent asks the server for an instance UID (RequestInstanceUid) and the server assigns one, a second later (the Go server): every message asks until then, none after, and over WebSocket the agent sends nothing more meanwhile (the server would assign a second UID to a second message asking). The run is 10 s: on a cold, busy ARC runner a Java client's first message has come 5.4 s after its start.
